On each output-facet dominance region, N(x+y)*N(2x−y) is one quadratic over Q(sqrt2), whose maximum is at an endpoint or a concave interior critical point. Therefore exact T_G=2sqrt2−1; source records 112 feasible cells. No finite-grid inference.
